title: Order status & tracking
content: Orders ship within 1-2 business days. A tracking link is emailed on dispatch and is also under Account > Orders. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days, express 1-2. If tracking shows no movement for 5 days, contact support and we will open a carrier investigation.

title: Reset your password
content: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and enter your email. A reset link arrives within 2 minutes and is valid for 30 minutes. Check spam. If you no longer have access to that email, support can verify identity and update it.

title: Refund policy
content: Annual and monthly plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase or renewal. After 14 days, refunds are prorated for annual plans only at manager discretion. Refunds go to the original payment method in 5-10 business days. Refunds above $200 require manager approval.

title: Cancel or pause subscription
content: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Access continues until the end of the billing period. You can pause for up to 3 months from the same page. Data is retained for 90 days after cancellation.

title: Invoices & billing details
content: Invoices are under Settings > Billing > Invoices as PDF. To change company name, VAT ID or billing email, edit Billing details; changes apply to future invoices. Past invoices can be reissued by support on request.

title: Add or remove team members
content: Admins can invite users under Settings > Team. Seats are billed pro-rata at $12 per user/month on Starter and $20 on Pro. Enterprise plans have custom seat pricing handled by our sales team. Removing a user stops billing at the next cycle.

title: Upgrade or change plan
content: Switch plans under Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal. Starter $29/mo, Pro $79/mo, Enterprise custom.

title: Export your data
content: Settings > Data > Export creates a CSV/JSON archive of all your projects. Large exports are emailed within 30 minutes. API access to the same data is available on Pro and Enterprise.

title: Integrations: Slack and Zapier
content: Connect Slack under Settings > Integrations > Slack and authorize the workspace. Zapier uses your API key found in Settings > API. If notifications stop, reconnect the integration; tokens expire after 90 days of inactivity.

title: Two-factor authentication
content: Enable 2FA under Settings > Security using any authenticator app. Save the 10 backup codes. If you lose your device and codes, support must verify your identity before disabling 2FA; this takes up to 24 hours.

title: Known issue: CSV import fails on large files
content: CSV imports above 50MB or 100k rows can time out with error E-413. Workaround: split the file into chunks under 50MB. A fix is scheduled for the next release. Engineering is tracking incident INC-2291.

title: Service status & outages
content: Live status is at status.example.com. If you see errors across the whole product, check there first. Current uptime SLA is 99.9% on Pro and 99.99% on Enterprise, with service credits for breaches handled by account management.

title: Security & data privacy
content: We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant; data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Security reports, suspected breaches, and data deletion requests must go to our security team and are never handled by general support.

title: Mobile app troubleshooting
content: If the app crashes on launch, update to the latest version, then clear cache (Settings > Storage). On iOS reinstall if the issue persists. Android 9 and below are no longer supported.

title: Feature requests & roadmap
content: We track requests on our public roadmap at roadmap.example.com. Upvote existing ideas or submit new ones. We cannot commit to dates for individual requests. Dark mode and SSO audit logs are currently planned.
